outcome: foetal weight above the 10th percentile at birth
finding: An increase in cerebral-placental-uterine (CPU) ratio was associated with lower odds of foetal weight above the 10th percentile at birth, showing higher accuracy than umbilico-cerebral (UC) ratio for predicting late-onset FGR.
gest_age: The study focused on late-onset FGR, defined after 32 weeks of gestational age, with key measurements taken between 35-37 weeks of gestation.
